text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The "Umanail ☆ Channel" live stream
was fire! All
the techniques they
dropped left me gagged. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But the one about how to do gradation
got me
lowkey kinda sad. Their
technique with the polish
was just way
too high-level.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...But what's the use in getting down?
I've just
gotta steal their goated
techniques! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And I'll start by going to a goated nail
salon!
... As soon as I actually find one.
